serum dioxin measurements in people potentially exposed to dioxin are a valuable tool for assessing exposure and for relating exposure to health effects.

the Seveso accident provides us with the opportunity to study the health effects of a well-defined, large population exposed to dioxin and to study other aspects of dioxin exposure and metabolism.
